cands.name: James Pericola
cands.bio: Democratic nominee. Attorney and founder of the government-policy consulting firm Seward Square Group. Former Clinton-administration appointee (special assistant to the NTSB chairman), congressional staffer (started with Sen. Bob Graham). Won the Aug 2026 primary with about 46%. Has not held elected office.
cands.local_ties: Raised in Central Florida; campaign address in Winter Garden. Husband and father of three.

record.text: Positions: protect Social Security/Medicare and ACA, lower housing and insurance costs, end income taxes under $100,000, John Lewis Voting Rights Act, opposes Amendment 3 without a replacement plan.

endorsements.text: Campaign site lists Orlando Sentinel, Reproductive Freedom for All, American Association for Justice, IBEW Local 606, UFCW Local 1625, Rep. Maxwell Frost, Rep. Jim McGovern, Orlando Mayor Buddy Dyer, Jennifer Jenkins and others.

cands.name: Joe Strada
cands.bio: Republican nominee. Founder of Strada Services (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, security), founded 2003, reported 4,000+ employees in 13 states. Started as a handyman. Won the Aug 2026 primary by 393 votes over Carey Baker; a machine recount confirmed it. Has not held elected office.
cands.local_ties: Company has offices in District 11; residence not stated. District 11 covers parts of Orange, Lake and Sumter counties. Rep. Daniel Webster is not running.

record.text: Primary: won by 393 votes (about 33.5% of the GOP vote per a search summary); recount did not change the result.
Campaign issues: investigate congressional insider trading, term limits, balanced budget. Did not answer the ClickOrlando questionnaire.

money_notes.text: Announced a $5 million personal contribution to his own campaign.

endorsements.text: Wikipedia's district page lists post-primary support from Trump and Gov. DeSantis; the Florida Press describes him as a Trump ally. Pre-primary endorsements on Wikipedia are not clearly attributed in the extract, so not listed.

cands.name: Ralph Groves
cands.bio: Libertarian nominee. Retired U.S. Army Reserve major; Defense Department analyst in the UK and at the Pentagon (campaign site gives 1999-2018). Former chairman of the Libertarian Party of Orange County. Age 74. No elected office found.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Ocoee, Florida (campaign site). Married, five children.

record.text: Positions: reduce Medicare fraud, enforce the War Powers Act (60-day limit), medical-only abortion access in hospitals, controlled legal immigration, expand oil refining and nuclear power, gradually reduce property taxes.
